channel: Stated directly in session on 4 Aug 2026, not exported from reports/omni-reference-frame-gallery.html. The gallery presented the evidence; the decision was given in conversation. Recorded this way because a browser-export timestamp would imply a click that did not happen.
scope: The three escalated A-wide stills that condition Phase 3.6 clips. The other 25 escalations in this review are deliberately unadjudicated: the arm is a bias-check slice that cannot carry a conclusion alone.

decisions.owner_reason: Accepted as a video reference frame. The frame is used alone to pin room identity for one clip, not as part of a scored four-view packet, so the packet-continuity objection that split the reviewers does not bear on this use.
